note: Reviewed 2026-09-09 for ordinary passenger-car speeding. Immediate-settlement rates changed on 2026-07-01: EUR 58 for the first 10 km/h, then EUR 12 per additional km/h in protected road contexts or EUR 7 elsewhere, plus the 2026 EUR 10.67 administrative fee. Formula text describes an available settlement, not a guaranteed court fine. Legal bands refer to officially retained excess after correction; raw GPS excess is only illustrative. The app does not have every zone, procedural or driver-status input, so higher bands have no invented scalar fine, points or ban duration. Sources and scope: docs/COUNTRY_RULE_REVIEW_2026-09-09.md.

bands.detail_template: Above +30 km/h, court referral can apply in built-up and special zones; on other roads the threshold is above +40. No single fine is assumed.

de.detail_template: Über +30 km/h droht innerorts und in besonderen Zonen ein Gerichtsverfahren; auf anderen Straßen liegt die Schwelle über +40. Kein pauschaler Betrag.

en.detail_template: Above +30 km/h, court referral can apply in built-up and special zones; on other roads the threshold is above +40. No single fine is assumed.

fr.detail_template: Au-delà de +30 km/h, renvoi au tribunal possible en agglomération et dans les zones spéciales ; ailleurs, le seuil est au-delà de +40. Aucun montant unique.

nl.detail_template: Boven +30 km/u kan de zaak naar de rechtbank gaan binnen de bebouwde kom en in bijzondere zones; elders ligt de grens boven +40. Geen vast bedrag.
